items.title: Configuration layers and overrides

details.condition: Config.loadInstanceState merges enabled sources in source order; project/config-directory/organization/managed sources are conditional.
details.summary: Order: well-known remote config, global config, OPENCODE_CONFIG, project files, discovered config directories and Markdown agents, OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT, active organization, managed directory, macOS managed preferences; later permission and legacy-tool compatibility transforms apply.

items.title: Global config files and instruction-array merge

details.condition: Layer merges use mergeConfigConcatArrays during instance loading; global file loader has its own ordered merges.
details.summary: Instructions concatenate and deduplicate when both layers provide them. Other fields use deep merge; do not assume all arrays concatenate.

items.title: Global config file order

details.condition: Global config is loaded before project layers.
details.summary: Loads config.json, opencode.json, then opencode.jsonc in that order.

items.title: Project and config directory discovery

details.condition: OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG excludes project discovery; OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR appends an explicit directory.
details.summary: Project file list is reversed before merge. Config directories include global config, discovered .opencode directories, home .opencode and the explicit config directory, deduplicated.

items.title: Environment and file substitutions

details.condition: ConfigVariable.substitute expands {env:VAR} and {file:path} when config text is loaded.
details.summary: File references resolve relative to the config directory, with home expansion; full contents are escaped into JSON text. This extractor never expands private configuration.

items.title: Markdown agent configuration

details.condition: Config directories are scanned for agent/agents Markdown and legacy mode/modes Markdown.
details.summary: Markdown body becomes the agent prompt; frontmatter fields configure it.

items.title: Built-in agents and configured agent overrides

details.condition: Agent.state merges default and user permissions, built-in agents and cfg.agent entries.
details.summary: Configured agents can disable agents or override model, variant, prompt, description, temperature, top_p, mode, steps, options and permissions.

items.title: Default agent selection

details.condition: Configured default_agent is used when valid, visible and not subagent-only; otherwise the first visible primary/all agent wins.
details.summary: Agent choice determines prompt replacement, permissions and options applied later.

items.title: Global, project and configured instructions

details.condition: Instruction.system loads discovered instructions; Claude compatibility may be disabled and project config may be disabled.
details.summary: First existing global candidate wins. Project search tries AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md when enabled, then deprecated CONTEXT.md and stops at the first filename with matches. Explicit instructions add globs/files or fetched URL bodies.

items.title: Instructions discovered while reading a file

details.condition: Instruction.resolve walks upward from the read target, within the instance directory, and excludes system/already-loaded/already-claimed files.
details.summary: Nearby instruction contents attach once per assistant message and are not a universal system prompt layer.

items.title: Runtime feature flags

details.condition: RuntimeFlags service reads environment configuration; selected flags inherit OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL unless explicitly set.
details.summary: Includes native LLM, WebSockets, plan, code mode, LSP, question, references, external skills, Claude compatibility, client and output-limit controls.

items.title: Configuration and catalog environment controls

details.condition: Flag fields read process environment; selected controls are evaluated at access time.
details.summary: Includes config path/content/directory, project-config disablement, permission override, catalog path/URL/fetch disablement and auto-compaction/pruning controls. Source extraction preserves variable names without reading their runtime values.
